selection.scope: Post-hoc diagnostic selection from existing measured candidates; not an independent performance test.
selection.selection_rule: single-device reference, frozen predicted Top1, and measured candidate nearest their latency midpoint

scope: Post-hoc development diagnosis, no model or scheduler modification and no independent validation claim.

predictions.scope: Original frozen costs and scheduler, reproduced without new labels; selected workloads/plans are post-hoc diagnostics. Scheduled intervals are predictions, not observed GPU activity.

traces.method: Only physical kernel/memcpy/memset ph=X events; unique CPU External id and scope containment. ac2g flow arrows and gpu_user_annotation spans are excluded. Missing branch events yield unavailable, not zero overlap.

timing_comparison.interpretation: Predeclared engineering check of profiling perturbation, not proof of causal fidelity or independent validation. Keep every trace even when the target fails.
